RoboFinder
v0.2.2 is out
RoboFinder is now more powerful, stable, and easier to fit into your
recon workflow
.
●
Installation
pip install robofinder
●
What's new?
•
Supports both single and multiple URLs
robofinder -u https://example.com
#or
robofinder -u urls.txt
•
Pipe results directly into other tools:
robofinder -u https://example.com -c | httpx
•
JSON output for automation:
robofinder -u https://example.com -c -f json
I also focused more on
data quality
than
raw speed
. Wayback lookups, especially on older targets, may take a l
ittle longer :(
